items.so: allow waxaan ku weydiisanayaa khayrkeeda iyo khayrka ku sugan dhexdeeda, iyo khayrka loo soo diray, waxaana kaa magangalayaa sharkeeda iyo sharka ku sugan dhexdeeda, iyo sharka loo soo diray.
items.st: allaahumma innii as-aluka khayrahaa, wa khayra maa fiihaa, wa khayra maa ursilat bihi, wa acuudu bika min sharrihaa wa sharri maa fiihaa, washarri maa ursilat bihi

chapters.title: دعاء الرعد
chapters.en: Invocation for when it thunder

items.t: ((سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ)).
items.e: (How perfect He is, (The One) Whom the thunder declares His perfection with His praise, as do the angles out of fear of Him.)
items.so: xumaan ilaahaybaa ka hufan allihii onkadku ku tasbiixsanaya mahadiisa, malaaigtuna ku tasbiixsanayso cabsidiisa darteed.
items.st: subxaanalladii yusabixurracdu bixamdihi wal malaaikatu min khiifatihi

chapters.title: من أدعية الاستسقاء
chapters.en: Some invocations for rain

items.t: ((اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مُغِيثاً مَرِيئاً مَرِيعاً، نَافِعاً غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ)).
items.e: (O Allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain, beneficial not harmful rain, now, not later.)
items.so: allow na waraabi roob, na roobeeya(biyo dhiga), jidiinkana mara, doogna noo bixiya, waxna anfacaya waxna aan dhibayn, dagdagna ah oona daahaynin.
items.st: allahumma asqinaa qaythan muqiithan marii-an mariican, naafican qayra daarrin, caajilan qayra aajilin
items.rf: abuu daawuud 1/303 waxaana saxiixyeelay albaani saxiix abii daawuud 1/116.

items.t: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا)).
items.e: (O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us.)
items.so: allow roob nasii, allow roob nasii, allow roob nasii.
items.st: Allahumma aqithnaa, Allahumma aqithnaa, Allahumma aqithnaa

items.t: ((اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبَادَكَ، وَبَهَائِمَكَ، وَانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَأَحْيِي بَلَدَكَ الْمَيِّتَ)).
items.e: (O Allah, provide water for Your servants and Your cattle, spread out Your mercy and resurrect Your dead land.)
items.so: allow waraabi adoomahaaga iyo xoolahaaga, faafina naxariistaada, nooleena baladkaagan dhintay(abaarta ah).
items.st: allaahumma isqi cibaadaka wa bahaaimaka wanshur raxmataka waxyi baladaka almayita

chapters.title: الدعاء إذا نزل المطر
chapters.en: Invocation for when it rains

items.t: ((اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّباً نَافِعاً)).
items.e: (O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud.)
items.so: allow ka dhig roob shubma, oo wax anfaca.
items.st: allaahumma sayyiban naafican

chapters.title: الذكر بعد نزول المطر
chapters.en: Supplication after it rains

items.t: ((مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ)).
items.e: (We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.)
items.so: waxaa nalagu roobeeyay dheeraadka(gallada) alle iyo naxariistiisa sababteed.
items.st: mudirnaa bifadlillaahi wa raxmatihi

chapters.title: من أدعية الاستصحاء
chapters.en: Invocation for the withholding of the rain

items.t: ((اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ، وَبُطُونِ الْأَوْدِيَةِ، وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ)).
items.e: (O Allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us, O Allah, (let it fall) on the pastures, hills, valleys and the roots of trees.)
items.so: allow geesaha na mari roobka, oo korkanaga ha marin, allow ku da-sii taagaga, iyo buuraha yaryar, iyo togaga dhexdooda iyo meelaha dhirtu ay ka baxdo.
items.st: allahumma xawaalaynaa walaa calaynaa. Alahumma calal aakaami wa diraabi, wa buduunil awdiyati, wa manaabitishshajari

chapters.title: دعاء رؤية الهلال
chapters.en: Invocation for sighting the new moon

items.t: ((اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالْإِسْلاَمِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ)).
items.e: (Allah is the greatest. O Allah, let the crescent loom above us in safety, faith, peace, and Islam, and in agreement with all that You love and pleases You. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.)
items.so: ilaahaybaa weyn, allow noogu bilsii bishan amni iyo iimaan, nabadgalyo iyo islaam, iyo waafajin waxa aad jeceshahay, rabiganow, raalina aad katahay, rabiganaga iyo rabigaaguba waa ilaahay.
items.st: allaahu akbar, allaahumma ahilhu calaynaa bil amni wal iimaani, wassalaamati wal-islaami wattowfiiqi limaa tuxibbuhu wa tardaa rabunaa wa rabuka allaahu

chapters.title: الدعاء عند إفطار الصائم
chapters.en: Invocations for breaking the fast

items.t: ((ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ)).
items.e: (The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched, and reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.)
items.so: oonkii wuu tagay, xididadiina wey qoyeen, ajirkiina wuu sugnaaday inshaa alaah.
items.st: dahaba addamau wabtallatilcuruuqu, wa thabatal ajru in shaa allaah

items.t: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي)).
items.e: (O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which envelopes all things, that You forgive me.)
items.so: allow anigu waxaan kugu waydiisanayaa naxariistaada, taasoo deeqday wax kasta, inaad ii dambi dhaafto.
items.st: allahumma innii as-aluka biraxmatika allatii wa sicat kulla shay-in an taqfira lii

chapters.title: الدعاء قبل الطعام
chapters.en: Invocations before eating

items.t: ((إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَاماً فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ بسمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ)).
items.e: (When you are about to eat, you should say:(Bismil-lah.)and if you forget to say it before starting, then you should say (when you remember):In the name of Allah in it’s beginning and end.)
items.so: magaca ilaahay ayaan ku bilaabayaa bilowgiisa iyo aakhirkiisaba.
items.st: haddii cuno midkiin cunto ha yiraahdo:bismillaah, haddii uu halmaamana marka ugu horaysa ha dhaho{bismillaahi fii awwalihi wa aakhirihi
items.rf: waxaa soo saaray abuu daawuud 3/347 iyo tirmidi 4/288.

items.t: ((مَنْ أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ الطَّعَامَ فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ، وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ لَبَناً فَلْيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ)).
items.e: (Whomever Allah feeds, should say:(O Allah, bless it for us and feed us better than it.) and whomever Allah gives milk to drink should say:(O Allah, bless it for usand give us more of it.))
items.so: allahumma baarik lanaa fiihi, wa zidnaa minhu qofkii uu ilaahay quudiyo quud ha yiraahdo: allow noo barakee, naguna quudi wax ka khayr badan qofkiiuu ilaahay waraabiyana caano ha yiraahdo: allow noo barakee, noona korddhi (siyaadi).
items.st: allahumma baarik lanaa fiihi, wa adcimnaa khayran minhu

chapters.title: الدعاء عند الفراغ من الطعام
chapters.en: Invocations after eating

items.t: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ)).
items.e: (All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might nor power from myself.)
items.so: waxaa mahad leh allihii igu quudiyay quudkan, iguna irsaaqay, iyadoon jirin xeelad iyo awood xaggayga ka ahaatay.
items.st: alxamdu lillaahi alladii adcamanii haadaa warasaqaniihi min qayri xawlin minnii walaa quwwah
items.rf: waxaa soo saaray culumada sunanta nisaai mooyee, eeg: attirmidi 3/159.

items.t: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً كَثِيراً طَيِّباً مُبَارَكاً فِيهِ، غَيْرَ [مَكْفِيٍّ وَلاَ ] مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنَىً عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا)).
items.e: (Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise, a never-ending praise, a praise which we will never bid farewell to and an indispensable praise, He is our Lord.)(There are other views as regards to the understanding of this supplication, from them: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise. He is The One Who is sufficient, feeds and is not fed. The One Who is longed for, along with that which is with Him and The One Who is needed, He is our Lord.)
items.so: Mahad ilaahaybaa leh, wuxuuna leeyahay mahad badan oo wanaagsan oo barakaysan, oo aan laga maarmi karin, lagana tagi karin, lagana deeqtoomi karin rabigayagow.
items.st: alxamdu lillaahi xamdan kathiiran dayyiban mubaarakan fiihi, qayra makfiyin walaa muwadacin, walaa mustaqnan canhu rabbanaa

chapters.title: دعاء الضيف لصاحب الطعام
chapters.en: A dinner guest's invocation for his host

items.t: ((اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُم، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ)).
items.e: (O Allah, bless for them, that which You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy upon them.)
items.so: allow u barakee waxa aad ku irsaaqday, una dambi dhaaf una naxariiso.
items.st: allaahumma baarik lahum fiimaa rasaqtahum, waqfir lahum warxamhum

chapters.title: التعريض بالدعاء لطلب الطعام أو الشراب
chapters.en: Invocation for someone who gives you drink or offers it to you

items.t: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي، وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي)).
items.e: (O Allah, feed him who fed me, and provide with drink him who provided me with drink.)
items.so: allow quudi qofka i quudiyey, waraabina qofka i waraabiyay.
items.st: allahumma adcim man adcamanii wasqi man saqaanii

chapters.title: الدعاء إذا أفطر عند أهل بيت
chapters.en: Invocation for a family who invites you to break your fast with them

items.t: ((أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ)).
items.e: (May the fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angles send prayers upon you.)
items.so: ha idinka afureen dadka soomani, hana cuneen cuntadiina baariyaalku, hana idinku sallido malaaigtu.
items.st: afdara cindakum assaaimuun, wa akala dacamakumul-abraar, wa sallat calaykum al-malaaikatu
items.rf: sunan abii daawuud 3/367. iyo ibnu maajah 1/556.

chapters.title: دعاء الصائم إذا حضر الطعام ولم يفطر
chapters.en: Invocation for someone who offers you food when you are fasting, which you decline

items.t: ((إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُجِبْ، فَإِنْ كَانَ صَائِماً فَلْيُصَلِّ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُفْطِراً فَلْيَطْعَمْ)) ، وَمَعْنَى فَلْيُصَلِّ أَيْ فَلْيَدْعُ.
items.so: haddii loo yeero midkiin ha ajiibo, haddii uu soomanyahayna ha duceeyo, haddii uu afuranyahayna ha cuno.

chapters.title: ما يقول الصائم إذا سابه أحد
chapters.en: What to say when you are fasting and someone is rude to you

items.t: ((إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ)).
items.e: (I am fasting, I am fasting.)
items.so: anigu waan soomanahay, waan soomanahay.
items.st: innii saaim innii saaim

chapters.title: الدعاء عند رؤية باكورة الثمر
chapters.en: Invocation for when you see the first dates of the season

items.t: ((اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مُدِّنَا)).
items.e: (O Allah, bless our fruit for us, bless our town for us, bless our saAA for us and bless our mudd for us.)(A saAA is equivalent to four mudds and a mudd is equivalent to a dry measure of an average man’s two palms.)
items.so: allow noo barakee midhahannaga, noona barakee magaaladanada, noona barakee saacanaga (halbeeg 4 mud ) noona barakee mudkanaga(saaca rubuciisa).
items.st: allahumma baarik lanaa fii thamarinaa, wa baarik lanaa fii madiinatinaa, wa baarik lanaa fii saacinaa, wa baarik lanaa fii muddinaa

chapters.title: دعاء العطاس
chapters.en: Invocation for sneezing

items.t: ((إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُم فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: يَرحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَلْيَقُلْ: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ)).
items.e: (When one of you sneezes he should say:(All praise if for Allah.) and his brother or companion should say to him: (May Allah have mercy upon you.) and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:(May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.))
items.so: Haddii uu hindhiso midkiin ha yiraahdo alxamdulillaahi,(mahad ilaahaybaa leh) walaakiisna ama saaxiibkiis ha ku yiraahdo:(yarxamukallaahu)(ilaahay ha kuu naxariisto) marka uu ku dhaho yarxamukallaah ha yiraahdo:(yahdiikumullaa hu wa yuslixu baalakum)(ilaahay ha idin hanuuniyo, hana hagaajiyo arimihiina).

chapters.title: ما يقال للكافر إذا عطس فحمد الله
chapters.en: What to say to the disbeliever if he sneezes and praises Allah

items.t: ((يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ)).
items.e: (May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.)
items.so: u fiirso gaalka lama dhihin yarxamukallaahu alle ha kuu naxariisto.waayo gaalku naxariista ilaahay wuu ka fogyahay.
items.st: haddii uu hindhiso gaalku oo uu dhaho alxamdu lillaahi, ku dhe:{yahdiikumullaahu wa yuslixu baala- kum

chapters.title: الدعاء للمتزوج
chapters.en: Invocation for the groom

items.t: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ)).
items.e: (May Allah bless for you (your spouse) and bless you, and may He unite both of you in goodness.)
items.so: ilaahay ha kuu barakeeyo, adigana korkaaga ha barakeeyo, khayrna ha idinku kulmiyo.
items.st: baarakallaahu laka wabaaraka calayka wa jamaca baynakumaa fii khayrin
items.rf: waxaa soo saaray culumada sunanta nisaai mooyee, eeg: saxiix tirmidi 1/316.

chapters.title: دعاء المتزوج و شراء الدابة
chapters.en: The groom’s supplication on the wedding night or when buying an animal

items.t: إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ أَحَدُكُمُ امْرَأَةً، أَوْ إِذَا اشْتَرَى خَادِماً فَلْيَقُلْ: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى بَعِيراً فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِذِرْوَةِ سَنَامِهِ وَلْيَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ)).
items.e: (when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say:(O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that you have made her inclined towards, and I take refuge with You from the evil within her and the evil that you have made her inclined towards.))(and if you buy a camel, then you should take hold of it’s hump and say likewise.)
items.so: Haddii uu guursado midkiin haweenay, amase soo iibsado adeege, ha yiraahdo: allow waxaan anigu ku waydiisanayaa khayrkeeda iyo khayrka aad ku abuurtay, waxaana kaa magangalayaa sharkeeda iyo sharka aad ku abuurtay. haddii uu soo iibsado ritti (awr) ha qabto meesha ugu saraysa kuruskiisa hana dhaho sidii oo kale.
items.st: allahumma innii as-aluka khayrahaa, wa khayra maa jabaltahaa calayhi, wa acuudu bika min sharrihaa wa sharri maa jabaltahaa calayhi
items.rf: abuu daawuud 2/248. iyo ibnu maa- jah 1/617.

chapters.title: الدعاء قبل إتيان الزوجة
chapters.en: Invocation to be recited before intercourse

items.t: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا)).
items.e: (In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what you have blessed us with.)
items.so: Magaca ilaahay, allow naga dheeree shaydaanka kana dheeree shaydaanka waxa (awlaada) aad nagu irsaaqday.
items.st: bissmillaah, allaahumma jannibnaa al-shaydaana wa jannibi-shaydaana maa rasaqtanaa

chapters.title: دعاء الغضب
chapters.en: Invocation for anger

items.t: ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ)).
items.e: (I take refuge with Allah from the accursed devil.)
items.so: waxaan ilaahay uga magan galayaa shaydaanka laga dheereeyey naxariista ilaahay.
items.st: acuudu billaahi minashaydaanirrajiim

chapters.title: دعاء من رأى مبتلى
chapters.en: What to say if you see someone afflicted by misfortune

items.t: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً)).
items.e: (All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with and Who most certainly favoured me over much of His creation.)
items.so: waxaa mahad leh allihii iga caafiyay waxa uu kugu ibtileeyay, igana fadilay (doortay) kuwo badan oo uunkiisa kamid ah.
items.st: alxamdu lillaahi alladii caafaanii mimmaa ibtalaaka bihi, wa faddalanii calaa kathiirin mimman khalaqa tafdiilaa

chapters.title: ما يقال في اﻟﻤﺠلس
chapters.en: What to say while sitting in an assembly

items.t: ((عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه قَاَلَ: كَانَ يُعَدُّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَجْلِسِ الوَاحِدِ مِائَةُ مَرَّةٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَقُومَ: ((رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفُورُ)).
items.e: (Ibn AAumar  said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah  would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up: (O my Lord, forgive me and turn towards me (to accept my repentance). Verily You are The Oft-Returning. The Oft-Forgiving.))
items.so: rabbiyow ii dambi dhaaf oo iga toobad aqbal, adigu waxaad tahay toobad aqbal badane dambi dhaaf badan.
items.st: Waxaa laga wariyey ibnu cumar (r.c) inuu yiri: waxaa loo tiring-jiray rasuulka alle s.c.w halkii fadhiba boqol mar oo uu yiraahdo inta uusan kicin:{ rabbiqfir lii wa tub calayya, innaka antattawwaabulqafuuru

chapters.title: كفارة اﻟﻤﺠلس
chapters.en: The Expiation of Assembly - Kaffaratul-Majlis

items.t: ((سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ)).
items.e: (How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You.  I bear witness that None has the right to be worshipped except You.  I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.)
items.so: allow xumaan waad ka hufantahay mahadna adaa leh, waxaan qirayaa inuusan jirin ilaah xaq lagu caabudo adiga mooyee, dambi dhaaf ayaan ku weydiisanayaa,waana kuu toobad keenayaa.
items.st: Subxaanakallaahunna wa bixamdika ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illaa anta astaqfiruka wa atuubu ilayk
items.rf: waxaa soo saaray culumada sunanta. Eeg: saxiix tirmidi 3/153.

chapters.title: الدعاء لمن قال غفر الله لك
chapters.en: vocation for someone who says: May Allah forgive you

items.e: (AAabdullah Ibn Sarjis  said: ‘I went to see the Prophet  and ate from his food and then said to him: (May Allah forgive you, O Messenger of Allah.) he  replied: (and you.))
items.so: adigana ilaahay hakuu dambi dhaafo.

chapters.title: الدعاء لمن صنع إليك معروفا
chapters.en: Invocation for someone who does good to you

items.t: ((جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً)).
items.e: (If someone does you a favour and you say: (May Allah reward you with goodness.) then you have indeed excelled in praising him.)
items.so: ilaahay khayr ha kugu abaalmariyo.
items.st: jasaakallaahu khayran

chapters.title: ما يعصم الله به من الدجال
chapters.en: Invocation for Allah's protection from the False Messiah

items.t: ((مَنْ حَفِظَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ عُصِمَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ)) ، وَالْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَتِهِ عَقِبَ التَّشَهُّدِ الْأَخِيرِ مِنْ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
items.e: (Dajjal: among the great signs of the last hour and the greatest trials to befall mankind, which every Prophet has warned about.  Most of mankind will folow him. He will appear from Asbahan, Iran at the time when Muslims will conquer Constantinople.  He will be given special powers and will make the truth seem false and vice versa. He will claim to be righteous and then he will claim prophet-hood and finally, divinity. From his features is that he will be blind in his right eye which is a definite proof that contradicts his claim to be Allah as it is a sign of imperfection.  The word Kafir will be written between his eyes which every believer, literate or illiterate will recognise.)(Whoever memorises the first ten verses of soorat Al-Kahf will be protected from Dajjal.)(One should also seek refuge with Allah from the tribulations of the Dajjal after the last tashahhud in prayer.(Refer to supplications #55 & #56))
items.so: Waxaa kaloo kaa ilaalinaya dajaal cawarka U magan-galka aad uga magan gasho ilaahay fidnadiisa salaad kasta ataxiyaatkeeda danbe.
items.st: qofkii xafida toban aayadood oo kamida billowga suurada alkahfi, waa laga ilaaliyay dajjaal cawar fidnadiisa

chapters.title: الدعاء لمن قال إني أحبك في الله
chapters.en: Invocation for someone who tells you I love you for the sake of Allah

items.t: ((أَحَبَّكَ الَّذِي أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ)).
items.e: (May He, for whom you have loved me, love you.)
items.so: haku jeclaado allihii dartiis aad ii jeclaatay.
items.st: axabbakalladii axbabtanii lahu

chapters.title: الدعاء لمن عرض عليك ماله
chapters.en: Invocation for someone who offers you a share of his wealth

items.t: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ)).
items.e: (May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth.)
items.so: ilaahay ha kuu barakeeyo ehelkaaga iyo hantidaadaba.
items.st: Baarakallaahu laka fii ahlika wa maalika

chapters.title: الدعاء لمن أقرض عند القضاء
chapters.en: Invocation (upon receipt of the loan) for someone who lends you money

items.t: ((بارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ)).
items.e: (May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth. Surely commendation and payment are the reward for a loan.)
items.so: ilaahay ha kuu barakeeyo ehelkaaga iyo hantidaadaba, abaalka daynku waa mahadnaq iyo gudid.
items.st: Baarakallaahu laka fii ahlika wa maalika innamaa jazaaussalafi alxamdu wal adaau

chapters.title: دعاء الخوف من الشرك
chapters.en: Invocation for fear of Shirk

items.t: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ)).
items.e: (shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him.  This can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)(O Allah, I take refuge in You lest I should commit shirk with You knowingly and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly.)
items.so: allow anigu waxaan kaa magan galayaa inaan kuu shariik yeelo anigoo ogsoon, waxaana dambidhaaf kaa waydiisanayaa waxa aanan ogayn.
items.st: allahumma innii acuudu bika an ushrika bika wa anaa aclamu, wa astaqfiruka limaa laa aclamu
items.rf: axmad 4/403 iyo qayrkiis. Eeg saxiix aljaamic:3/233.

chapters.title: الدعاء لمن قال بارك الله فيك
chapters.en: Invocation for someone who tells you: May Allah bless you

items.t: ((وَفِيكَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ)).
items.e: (Aaishah reported that the Messenger of Allah  was given a sheep and he ordered for it’s distribution.  When the servant would come back (from distributing it), AAaishah would ask: ‘What did they say?’, he replied: They would supplicate: (May Allah bless you all.) AAaishah would then say: (and may Allah bless them.))(we return their supplication in a similar way and our reward remains with us.)
items.so: adigana ilaahay haku barakeeyo.
items.st: wa fiika baarakallaahu
items.rf: waxaa soo saaray ibnu sani boga 138 lambarka 278.

chapters.title: دعاء كراهية الطيرة
chapters.en: Invocation against evil portent

items.t: ((اللَّهُمَّ لاَ طَيْرَ إِلاَّ طَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ خَيْرَ إِلاَّ خَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ)).
items.e: (This supplication is used whenever one initially thinks a casual event or occurrence to foretell good or evil, using it as a basis to determine which action he should undertake, but he then denounces such a link, relies on Allah and then says this supplication as an expiation for this act, since it falls under the category of shirk.)(O Allah, there is no omen but there is reliance on You, there is no good except Your good and none has the right to be worshipped except You.)
items.so: allow baasayse majiro waxaad baas kadhigto mooyaane, khayrna majiro khayrkaaga mooyaane, ilaah xaq lagu caabudo majiro adiga mooyee.
items.st: allahumma laa dayra illaa dayruka, walaa khayra illaa khayruka, walaa ilaaha qayruka

chapters.title: دعاء الركوب
chapters.en: Invocation for riding in a vehicle or on an animal

items.t: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾، ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي؛ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
items.e: (In the name of Allah and all praise is for Allah.  How perfect He is, the One Who has placed this (transport) at our service and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny.  All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah,  Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. How perfect You are, O Allah, verily I have wronged my soul, so forgive me, for surely none can forgive sins except You.)
items.so: magaca ilaahay ayaan ku fuulayaa, mahadna ilaahaybaa leh, waxaa xumaan ka nasahan eebaha noosahley kan,mana nihin kuwo kara leyligiisa) anaguna xagga eebahanno yaannu u gadoomeynaa.),mahadna ilaahay baa leh, mahadna ilaahay baa leh, mahadna ilaahay baa leh,ilaahaybaa wayn, ilaahaybaa wayn, ilaahaybaa wayn, nasahnaantaada, allow anigu waxaan dulmiyey naftayda, ee ii dambi dhaaf, ma dhaafo dambiyada adiga mooyee.
items.st: Bismillaah, alxamdu lillaah{subxaanalladii sakhkhara lanaa haadaa, wa maa kunnaa lahu muqriniin, wa innaa ilaa rabbinaa la munqalibuun, alxamdu lillaahi, alxamdu lillaahi, alx- amdu lillaahi, allaahu akbaru, allaahu akbaru, allaahu akbaru, subxaanakallahumma innii dalamtu nafsii faqfir lii, fa-innahu laa yaqfiruddunuuba illaa anta

chapters.title: دعاء السفر
chapters.en: Invocation for traveling

items.t: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَليفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ))، وإذا رَجَعَ قَالَهُنَّ وَزَادَ فِيهِنَّ: ((آيِبُونَ، تائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ)).
items.e: (Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, How perfect He is, The One Who has placed this (transport) at our service, and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny.  O Allah, we ask You for birr and taqwa in this journey of ours, and we ask You for deeds which please You.  O Allah, facilitate our journey and let us cover it’s distance quickly.  O Allah, You are The Companion on the journey and The Successor over the family, O Allah, I take refuge with You from the difficulties of travel, from having a change of hearts and being in a bad predicament, and I take refuge in You from an ill fated outcome with wealth and family.)(birr and taqwa: two comprehensive terms which individually, refer to all good actions and obedience i.e. performing the commanded actions and avoiding the prohibited actions.  When combined together, birr refers to doing those actions which have been commanded and taqwa refers to avoiding those actions which have been prohibited.)(A successor: one who succeeds another due to the latter’s absence or death.  This is the correct meaning of the word khaleefah; thus, it is incorrect to believe that Adam is the khaleefah (vicegerent, as is commonly translated) of Allah on earth because Allah is never absent, and will never die.  This supplication proves the correct understanding of this term and shows that Allah succeeds us and guards whom we leave behind when we die or are absent.)(upon returning the same supplication is recited with the following addition: (We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord.))
items.so: Eebaa weyn, eebaa weyn, eebaa weyn, waxaa nasahan eebaha noosahley kan,mana nihin kuwo kara leyligiisa) anaguna xagga eebahanno yaannu ayaan u gadoomaynaa.) Allow waxaan ku waydiisanaynaa socdaalkayagan, wanaag iyo taqwo (cabsi) iyo camal aad raali ka tahay, allow noo dhib-yaree safarkanagan, fogaanshihiisana,noo soo duub, allow adigaa ah saaxiibka safarka, iyo ka aan ku dhawrayno ehelka, allow waxaan kaa magan galayaa rafaadka safarka, iyo muuqaal xumo, iyo gadoon xumo xoolihii iyo reerkii marka uu soo laabto wuxuu dhihi: waan soo laabanay annagoo toobadkeen ah, caabudaynana ilaahay, rabigayagana mahadinayno.
items.st: allaahu akbar, allaahu akbar, allaahu akbar, subxaanalladii sakhkhara lanaa haadaa wamaa kunnaa lahuu muqriniin wa innaa ilaa rabbinaa la munqalibuun allaahumma innaa nas-aluka fii safarinaa haadaa al-birra wa taqwaa, wa minal camali maa tardaa, allaahumma hawwin calaynaa safaranaa haadaa, wadwi cannaa bucdahu, allaahumma anta saaxibu fissafri, wal khaliifatu fil- ahli,allaahumma innii acuudu bika min wacthaa-issafari, wa ka-aabatil mandari, wa suu-il munqalabi fil-maali wal-ahli

chapters.title: دعاء دخول القرية أو البلدة
chapters.en: Invocation for entering a town or city

items.t: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّياطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ، وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا)).
items.e: (O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all that they envelop, Lord of the seven earths and all that they carry, Lord of the devils and all whom they misguide, Lord of the winds and all whom they whisk away. I ask You for the goodness of this village, the goodness of its inhabitants and for all the goodness found within it and I take refuge with You from the evil of this village, the evil of its inhabitants and from all the evil found within it.)
items.so: allow rabbigii todobada cirar iyo waxay hadheeyeen rabigooda ahaayow, todobada dhulna iyo waxa ay sidaan rabigooda ahaayow, shayaadiinta iyo waxa ay duufsadeen (lumiyeen) rabigooda ahaayow, dabaylahana iyo waxa ay kiciyeen rabigooda ahaayow, waxaan ku waydiisanayaa khayrka tuuladan iyo khayrka ehelkeeda, iyo khayrka ku dhex sugan. Waxaana kaa magan galayaa sharkeeda iyo sharka ehelkeeda iyo sharka ku dhex sugan.
items.st: allahumma rabbassamaawaati sabci wamaa adlalna, wa rabbal-ardiina wamaa aqlalna, wa rabbashayaadiini wamaa adlalna, wa rabba riyaaxi wa maa darayna. As-aluka khayra haadihi al-qaryati wa khayra ahlihaa, wa khayra maa fiihaa, wa acuudu bika min sharrihaa, wa sharri ahlihaa, wa sharri maa fiihaa
items.rf: w.w.xaakim waxaana saxiixyeelay kuna waafaqay dahabi 2/100.

chapters.title: دعاء دخول السوق
chapters.en: Invocation for entering a market

items.t: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لاِ يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)).
items.e: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise.  He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die.  In His hand is all good and He is over all things, omnipotent.)
items.so: ilaah xaq lagu caabudo majiro ilaahay mooyee, kaligii malahana cid wax la wadaagta, wuxuu leeyahay boqornimo wuxuuna leeyaahay mahadda, isagaa wax nooleeya, isagaanaa wax dila, wuuna noolyahay nolal daaim ah, mana dhinto, gacantiisa ayuu khayrku ku sugan yahay, wax kastana wuu karaa.
items.st: laa ilaaha illallaahu waxdahu, laaa shariika lahu lahulmulku wa lahulxamdu yuxyii wa yumiitu wa huwa calaa kulli shay-in qadiir

chapters.title: الدعاء إذا تعس المركوب
chapters.en: Invocation for when your vehicle or mount begins to fail

items.e: (In the name of Allah.)
items.so: magaca ilaahay.
items.st: bismillaahi
items.rf: abuu daawuud 4/152, albaanina wuu saxiixyeely saxiix abiidaawuud 3/941.

chapters.title: دعاء المسافر للمقيم
chapters.en: The traveler's invocation for the one he leaves behind

items.t: ((أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لاَ تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ)).
items.e: (I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.)
items.so: waxaan idinku amaanaynayaa eebaha amaanadiisu lumin.
items.st: Astawdicikumullaaha alladii laa. tadiicu wadaa-icuhu

chapters.title: دعاء المقيم للمسافر
chapters.en: The resident's invocations for the traveler

items.t: (( أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ، وَأَمَانَتَكَ، وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ)).
items.e: (I place your religion, your faithfulness and the ends of your deeds in the trust of Allah.)
items.so: waxaan ilaahay kaaga dalbayaa ammaangalin diintaada iyo amaanadaada iyo khaatumada camalkaaga.
items.st: astawdicullaaha diinaka, wa amaanataka, wa khawaatiima camalika

items.t: ((زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الخَيْرَ حَيْثُ ما كُنْتَ)).
items.e: (May Allah endow you with taqwa, forgive your sins and facilitate all good for you, wherever you be.)(taqwa: a comprehensive term which refers to all good actions and obedience i.e. performing the commanded actions and avoiding the prohibited actions.)
items.so: ilaahay sahay ha kaaga yeelo cabsidiisa, hana kuu kordhiyo taqwo (cabsi) dambigaagana ha dhaafo, hana kuu sahlo khayrka meel aad joogtaba.
items.st: sawwadakallaahu attaqwaa, wa qafara danbaka, wa yassara laka alkhayra xaythu maa kunta

chapters.title: التكبير و التسبيح في سير السفر
chapters.en: Glorifying and magnifying Allah on the journey

items.t: قَالَ جَابِرٌ رضي الله عنه: ((كُنَّا إِذَا صَعَدْنَا كَبَّرْنَا، وَإِذَا نَزَلْنَا سَبَّحْنَا)).
items.e: Jabir said: Whenever we went up a hill we would say Allaahu 'Akber (Allah is the Most Great) and when we descended we would say Subhaanallaah (Glory is to Allah)
items.so: wuxuu yiri jaabir alle ha ka raali ahaadee: waxaan ahayn marka aan kor fuulno kuwii yiraahda (allaahu akbar), haddii aan hoos u dagnana waxaan ahayn kuwii yiraahda (subxaanallaah).

chapters.title: دعاء المسافر إذا أسحر
chapters.en: The traveler's invocation at dawn

items.t: ((سَمَّعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ، وَحُسْنِ بَلاَئِهِ عَلَيْنَا، رَبَّنَا صاحِبْنَا، وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا، عَائِذاً بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ)).
items.e: (May a witness, be witness to our praise of Allah for His favours and bounties upon us.  Our Lord, protect us, show favour on us and deliver us from every evil.  I take refuge in Allah from the fire.)
items.so: waxaa ka marag ah marag, mahadda ilaahay, iyo nicmada wanaagsan ee uu nagu galadaystay. Rabiganow nala jir, nasiina nicmadaada iyo dheeraadkaaga weyn, anigoo kaa magangalaya naarta.
items.st: sammaca saamicun bixamdillaahi, wa xusni balaa-ihi calaynaa. Rabbanaa saaxibnaa wa afdil calaynaa caaidan minannaari

chapters.title: الدعاء إذا نزل مترلا في سفر أو غيره
chapters.en: Invocation for a layover (stopping along the way) on the journey

items.t: ((أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ)).
items.e: (I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil that He has created.)
items.so: Waxaan kaga magan galayaa kalmadaha eebe ee dhamayskatiran waxa uu abuuray sharkiisa.
items.st: acuudu bikalimaatillaahittaamaati min sharri maa khalaqa

chapters.title: ذكر الرجوع من السفر
chapters.en: What to say upon returning from a Journey

items.t: ((يُكَبِّرُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَرَفٍ ثَلاَثَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزابَ وَحْدَهُ)).
items.e: (Ibn AAumar  reported that the Messenger of Allah  on return from a battle or from performing the pilgrimage would say at every high point: (Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest.) and then he would say: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner.  To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.  We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord.  Allah fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant, and single-handedly defeated the allies.))
items.so: ilaah majiro xaq lagu caabudo ilaahay mooyee, kaligii, malaha shariik (wadaage) wuxuu leeyahay boqornimada, wuxuuna leeyahay mahadda, wax walbana wuu karaa, waan soo laabanay annagoo toobadkeen ah, caabudaynana ilaahay, rabigayagana mahadinayna, ilaahay wuu rumeeyey ballankiisii, adoonkiisana wuu u gargaaray, gaashaan-buurtiina wuu jabiyey.
items.st: wuxuu dhahayaa dalcad kasta allaahu akbar saddex jeer, kadibna wuxuu dhihi:{ laa ilaaha illallaahu waxdahu laa shariika lahu, lahul mulku wa lahul-xamdu wa huwa calaa kulli shay-in qadiirun, aayibuuna taa-ibuuna caabiduuna lirabbinaa xaamiduuna, sadaqallaahu wacdahu, wa nasara cabdahu, wa hasamal-axsaaba waxdahu

chapters.title: ما يقول من أتاه أمر يسره أو يكرهه
chapters.en: What to say if something happens to please you or to displease you

items.t: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَسُرُّهُ قَالَ: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ)) وَإِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَكْرَهُهُ قَالَ: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ)).
items.e: When something happened that pleased him, the Prophet used to say:((Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmuus-saalihaat)). Praise is to Allah Who by His blessings all good things are perfected. And if something happened that displeased him, he used to say:((Alhamdulillaahi 'alaa kulli haal)).Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.
items.so: mahadda waxaa leh allihii nicmadiisa wanaagyadu ku taaamnoqonayeen. haddii uu u yimaado warka uu nacayo wuxuu dhihijiray: al-xamdu lillaah calaa kulli xaalin waa maahad ilaahaay si kastaba.
items.st: wuxuu dhihi jiray rasuulku s.c.w haddii uu u yimaado war uu ku farxo:{alxamdu lillaahi alladii binicmatihi tatimmu assaalixaatu
items.rf: waxaa soo saaray ibnu sani xaakimna wuu saxiixyeelay 1/499.

chapters.title: فضل الصلاة على النبي صلى الله عليه و سلم
chapters.en: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH

items.t: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلاَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْراً)).
items.e: (The Prophet (PBUH) said: ‘Whoever sends a prayer upon me, Allah sends ten upon him.)
items.so: wuxuu yiri raasuulku s.c.w: qofkii igu salliya hal mar, ilaahay ayaa ku saliyi toban jeer

items.t: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((لاَ تَجْعَلُوا قَبْرِي عِيداً وَصَلُّوا عَلَيَّ؛ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكُم تَبْلُغُنِي حَيْثُ كُنْتُمْ)).
items.e: (He (PBUH) also said: ‘Do not take my grave as a place of habitual ceremony.  Send prayers upon me, for verily your prayers reach me wherever you are.)
items.so: Haka yeelina qabrigayga ciid ama feesto(meel loo qasdiyo), ee igu salliya, salligiinuna wuu isoo gaarayaa meel kastood joogtaanba

items.t: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((الْبَخِيلُ مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ)).
items.e: (He (PBUH) also said: ‘A miser is one whom when I am mentioned to him,  fails to send prayers upon me.)
items.so: Wuxuuna yiri raasuulku s.c.w: bakhaylku waa ka agtiisa la igu sheegay een igu salliyin

items.t: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:((إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلاَئِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلاَمَ)).
items.e: The Prophet [PBUH] said:'Indeed Allah has angels who roam the earth and they convey to me the greetings (or prayers of peace) of my 'Ummah (nation).
items.so: Wuxuuna yiri raasuulku s.c.w: Waxaa u sugnaaday ilaahay malaa-ig wareegta dhulka, kuwaas oo iga soo gaadhsiinaya umadayda salaanta.

items.t: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ إِلاَّ رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ رُوحِيَ حَتَّى أَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمَ)).
items.e: The Prophet [PBUH] said: 'No one sends greetings (or prayers of peace) upon me but Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greetings
items.so: Wuxuuna yiri raasuulku s.c.w: majiro qof i salaamaya, haddii uu I salaamana, ilaahay ayaa iisoo celiya naftayda si aan uga celiyo(qofkaas) salaanta.

chapters.title: إفشاء السلام
chapters.en: spreading the greetings of Salam (Peace)

items.t: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((لاَ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا، وَلاَ تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا، أَوَلاَ أَدُلُّكُم عَلَى شَيْءٍ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبْتُم، أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ بَيْنَكُمْ)).
items.e: (The Messenger of Allah  said: ‘You shall not enter paradise until you believe, and you shall not believe until you love one another. Shall I not inform you of something, if you were to act upon it, you will indeed achieve mutual love for one another?  Spread the greeting amongst yourselves.)
items.so: Wuxuuna yiri raasuulku s.c.w: magalaysaan janada, illaa aad ka rumaaysaan, mana rumaynaysaan illaa aad is jeclaataan, ma idin tusaa wax haddii aad samaysaan aad is-jeclaanaysiin, faafiya salaanta dhexdiina.

items.t: ((ثَلاَثٌ مَنْ جَمَعَهُنَّ فَقَدْ جَمَعَ الْإِيمَانَ: الْإِنْصَافُ مِنْ نَفْسِكَ، وَبَذْلُ السَّلاَمِ لِلْعَالَمِ، وَالْإِنْفَاقُ مِنَ الإِقْتَارِ)).
items.e: (Aammar  said: ‘Three characteristics, whoever combines them, has completed his faith: to be just, to spread greetings to all people and to spend (charitably) out of the little you have.)
items.so: saddex qofkii kulmiya, wuxuu kulmiyey iimaankii, naftaada ood u garsoorto, caalamka ood nabad u fidisid, wax la bixittaanka gacantoo gaaban

items.t: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أيُّ الْإِسْلاَمِ خَيْرٌ قَالَ: ((تُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامَ، وَتَقْرأُ السَّلاَمَ عَلَى مَنْ عَرَفْتَ وَمَنْ لَمْ تَعْرِفْ)).
items.e: (Aabdullah Ibn Aamr  reported that a man asked the Prophet : ‘Which Islam is the best?’.  He  replied: Feed (the poor), and greet those whom you know as well as those whom you do not.)
items.so: Waxaa laga wariyey c/laahi ibnu camrin alle haka rali noqdee isaga iyo aabihiiba: in nini waydiiyey nabiga s.c.w howlaha islaamka teebaa ugu wanaagsan? Wuxuu yiri s.c.w: cuntadaad quudin, salaantana waad ku taaban qofkaad garato iyo kaadan garanba

chapters.title: كيف يرد السلام على الكافر إذا سلم
chapters.en: How to reply to a disbeliever if he says Salam to you

items.t: ((إذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا: وَعَلَيْكُمْ)).
items.e: (When the people of the Book greet you, reply by saying: (And upon you.))
items.so: wuxuu yiri s.c.w: haddii ay idin salaamaan ahlu kitaabku(yuhuud iyo nasaaaro) waxaad ku tiraahdaan:wacalaykum

chapters.title: الدُّعاءُ عِنْدَ سَمَاعِ صِياحِ الدِّيكِ ونَهِيقِ الْحِمَارِ
chapters.en: Invocation upon hearing the cock's crow or the bray of a donkey

items.t: ((إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ؛ فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكاً وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ؛ فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَاناً)).
items.e: (If you hear the crow of a rooster, ask Allah for his bounty for it has seen an angel and if you hear the braying of an ass, seek refuge in Allah for it has seen a devil.)
items.so: wuxuu yiri s.c.w: haddii aad maqashaan dhawaaqa diiqaqa, ilaahay waydiista fadligiisa,(dheeraadkiisa) waxay arkeen malag. Haddii aad maqashaan cida(dhawaaqa)dameerka ilaah ka magangala(oo shaydaanka iska naara), wuxuu arkay (dameerku) shaydaane.

chapters.title: دعاء نباح الكلاب بالليل
chapters.en: Invocation upon hearing a dog barking in the night

items.t: ((إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نُبَاحَ الْكِلاَبِ وَنَهِيقَ الْحَمِيرِ بِاللَّيْلِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُنَّ؛ فَإِنَّهُنَّ يَرَيْنَ مَا لاَ تَرَوْنَ)).
items.e: (If you hear the barking of dogs or the braying of asses at night, seek refuge in Allah for they see what you do not.)
items.so: haddii aad maqashaan habeen kii dhawaaqa ayda iyo dameeraha, shaydaanka iska naara (alle ka magan gala) waxay arkaan wax aydaan arag

chapters.title: الدعاء لمن سببته
chapters.en: Invocation for someone you have spoken ill to

items.t: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ)).
items.e: (O Allah, to any believer whom I have insulted, let that be cause to draw him near to You on the Day of Resurrection.)
items.so: Wuxuu yiri rasuulku s.c.w: allow mu-minkasta oon caayey uga dhig kaas (caydaas) dhawaansho xagaaga ah maalinta qiyaamo.

chapters.title: ما يقول المسلم إذا مدح المسلم
chapters.en: How a Muslim should praise another Muslim

items.t: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُم مَادِحاً صَاحِبَهُ لاَ مَحَالَةَ فَلْيَقُلْ: أَحْسِبُ فُلاَناً وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلاَ أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَداً، أَحْسِبُهُ – إِنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ ذَاكَ – كَذَا وَكَذَا)).
items.e: (He  said: ‘If anyone of you is impelled to praise his brother, then he should say: ‘I deem so-and-so to be…and Allah is his reckoner…and I don’t praise anyone, putting it (i.e. my praising) forward, in front of Allah’s commendation, however I assume him so and so’…if he knows that of him.)
items.so: Wuxuu yiri rasuulku s.c.w: haddii uu midkiin ammaanayo saaxiibkii laba-gooraba, ha yiraahdo: waxaan u malaynayaa hebal, ilaahaybaana i oge, mana u ammaanayo(taskiyaynayo) ilaahay qofna, waxaan u malaynayaa sidaa iyo sidaa.
items.st: {axsibu fulaanan wallaahu xasiibuhu, walaa uzakkii calallaahi axadaa

chapters.title: ما يقول المسلم إذا زكي
chapters.en: What a Muslim should say when he is praised

items.t: ((اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ، [وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْراً مِمَّا يَظُّنُّونَ])).
items.e: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of [and make me better than they imagine].
items.so: allow ha ii qaban waxay lee yihiin, iina dambi dhaaf waxayna ogayn, iigana yeel waxa ay malaynayaan khayr.
items.st: allaahumma laa tu-aakhidnii bimaa yaquuluuna, waqfir lii maa laa yacmaluuna, wajcalnii khayran mimmaa yadunnuuna

chapters.title: كيف يلبي المحرم في الحج أو العمرة ؟
chapters.en: The pilgrim's announcement of his arrival for Hajj or Umrah

items.t: ((لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ، لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ)).
items.e: (Here I am O Allah, (in response to Your call), here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am.  Verily all praise, grace and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.)
items.so: allow waa i kan anigoo ku ajiibay, cid wax kula wadaagta malihid, waana ku ajiibay, mahadda iyo nicmada iyo boqornimaduba adigay kuu sugnaadeen, cid wax kula wadaagtana majiraan.
items.st: labbaykallaahumma labbayka, labbayka laa shariika laka labbayka innal xamda wannicmata, laka wal-mulka, laa shariika laka

chapters.title: التكبير إذا أتى الركن الأسود
chapters.en: Saying Allahu Akbar when passing the Black Stone

items.t: ((طَافَ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْبَيْتِ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ كُلَّمَا أَتَى الرُّكْنَ أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ بِشَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ وَكَبَّرَ)).
items.e: (The Prophet  circled the KaAAbah on a camel, every time he reached the black stone he would point to it with his staff and say: (Allah is the greatest))
items.so: wuxuu nabigu s.c.w dawaafay baytka isagoo saaran rakuub( awr), markasta oo uu yimaado tiirka uu ku jiro dhagaxa madow( xajar-aswadka), wuxuu ku fiiqayay shay uu haystay (ul), wuuna takbiirsanayay, (allaahu akbar

chapters.title: الدعاء بين الركن اليماني والحجر الأسود
chapters.en: Invocation to be recited between the Yemenite Corner and the Black Stone

items.t: ((﴿رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ﴾)).
items.e: The Prophet PBUH used to say between the Yemeni corner and the black stone: (O our Lord, grant us the best in this life and the best in the next life, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.)
items.so: rabbiganow nasii aduunka dhexdiisa wanaag, aakhiro dhexdeedana wanaag, nagana ilaali cadaabka naarta.
items.st: rabbanaa aatinaa fiddunyaa xasanatan wa fil aakhirati xasanatan, wa qinaa cadaabannaar

chapters.title: دعاء الوقوف على الصفا والمروة
chapters.en: Invocation to be recited while standing at Safa and Marwah

items.t: لَمَّا دَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الصَّفَا قَرَأَ: ﴿إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ﴾ أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ)) فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّفَا فَرَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى رَأَى الْبَيْتَ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ، فَوَحَّدَ اللَّهَ وَكبَّرَهُ وَقَالَ: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بَيْنَ ذلكَ. قَالَ مِثْلَ هَذَا ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ)) الْحَدِيثُ. وَفِيهِ: ((فَفَعَلَ عَلَى الْمَرْوَةِ كَمَا فَعَلَ عَلَى الصَّفَا)).
items.e: (Jabir  said when describing the Prophet’s  pilgrimage: ‘…and when he approached mount Safa he recited: (Indeed Safa and Marwah are from the places of worship of Allah…) (I begin with what Allah began with.) so he started with Safa and climed it until he could see the KaAAbah, he then faced it and said: (Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest.) and then he would say the following three times making a supplication (one should make a personal supplication) after each time: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner.To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things amnipotent. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone.  He fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant and single-handedly defeated the allies.)) (he  would repeat this action at Marwah.)
items.so: wuxuuna ku bilaabay safo, wuuna koray, illaa uu ka arkay bayta, wuxuuna istiqbaalay qiblada, ilaahayna wuu waxiday, wuuna weyneeyey, wuxuuna yiri: laa ilaaha illallaahu waxdahu laa shariika lahu lahul mulku walahu al-xamdu wahuwa calaa kulli shay-in qadiirun, laa ilaaha illalaahu waxdahu anjaza wacdahu, wanasara cabdahu, wa hazamal-axzaaba waxdahu kadib wuu duceeyay,intii u dhaxaysay intaas, wuxuuna yiri ducadan saddex mar xadiiskan waxaa kaloo ku jiray, in uu sameeyay buurta marwana sida uu sameeyay buurta safa.
items.st: markii uu u soo dhawaaday rasuulku s.c.w buurta safa, wuxuu akhriyey aayadan{innasafaa wal-marwata min shacaa-irillaahi... waxaan ku billaabayaa wuxuu ilaahay ku billaabay

chapters.title: الدعاء يوم عرفة
chapters.en: Invocation to be recited on the Day of Arafat

items.t: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((خَيْرُ الدُّعَاءِ دُعَاءُ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ، وَخَيْرُ مَا قُلْتُ أَنَا وَالنَّبيُّونَ مِنْ قَبْلِي: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ)).
items.e: (The best of supplications is the supplication on the day of AAarafah and the best which I and the Prophets before me have said (is): (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all praise and sovereignty and He is over all things omnipotent.))
items.so: ilaah majiro xaq lagu caabudo ilaahay mooyee, kaligii, ma laha wadaage wax la wadaaga, wuxuu leeyahay boqornimada, wuxuuna leeyahay mahadda, wax walbana wuu karaa. 120- xussidda ilaahay mashcaril xaraamka agtiisa.
items.st: Duco waxaa ugu khayr badan ducada maalinta carafo, waxa ugu khayr badan een dhahay aniga iyo anbiyadii iga horaysayba{ laa ilaaha illallaahu waxdahu laa shariika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul xamdu wa huwa calaa kulli shay-in qadiirun

chapters.title: الذكر عند المشعر الحرام
chapters.en: Supplication to be recited at the sacred area of Muzdalifah

items.t: رَكِبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْقَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَشْعَرَ الْحَرَامَ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ (فَدَعَاهُ، وَكَبَّرَهُ، وَهَللَّهُ، وَوَحَّدَهُ) فَلَمْ يَزَلْ وَاقِفاً حَتَّى أَسْفَرَ جِدَّاً فَدَفَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمسُ.
items.e: The Prophet rode his camel, Al-Qaswa, until he reached the sacred area (Al-Mash aril Haraam). Then he faced the Qiblah and invoked Allah, and repeatedly said the words: Allaahu Akbar (Allah is the Most Great), Allaahu Ahad (Allah is One) and Laa ilaaha illallaah (There is none worthy of worship but Allah). He remained stationary until the sky became yellow with the dawn, and then pressed on before sunrise.
items.so: Wuxuu fuulay rasuulku s.c.w hashiisii la oranjiray qaswaa, ilaa uu ka yimid mashcaril xaraamka, kadib wuxuu u qaabilay qiblada, markaasuu duceeyey oo uu baryay ilaahay, wuuna wayneeyey, wuxuuna yidhi (laa ilaaha illaahu), wuuna waxiday) kama uusan suulin inuu taagnaado ilaa waagu ka guduutay si aad ah, kadibna wuu dhaqaajiyey intaysan soo bixin cadceedu (qorraxdu)

chapters.title: التكبير عند رمي الجمار مع كل حصاة
chapters.en: Saying Allahu Akbar while stoning the three pillars at Mina

items.t: ((يُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا رَمَى بِحَصَاةٍ عِنْدَ الْجِمَارِ الثَّلاَثِ، ثُمَّ يَتَقَدَّمُ، ويَقِفُ يَدْعُو مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبلَةِ، رَافِعاً يَدَيْهِ بَعْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ الْأُولَى وَالثَّانِيَةِ. أَمَّا جَمْرَةُ الْعَقَبَةِ فَيَرْمِيهَا وَيُكَبِّرُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ وَيَنْصَرِفُ وَلاَ يَقِفُ عِنْدَهَا)).
items.e: The Prophet PBUH said Allaahu 'Akbar (Allah is the Most Great) with each pebble he threw at the three pillars. Then he went forward, stood facing the Qiblah and raised his hands and called upon Allah. That was after (stoning) the first and second pillar As for the third, he stoned it and called out Allahu Akbar with every pebble he threw but when he was finished he left without standing at it (for supplications).
items.so: wuxuu dhahayaa (allaahu akbar) markasta oo uu ku tuuro quruuraxa(dhagaxa) jamaraatka saddexda ah, kadibna horay ayuu u soconayaa,wuuna istaagayaa isagoo ducaynaya una jeeda qiblada, kadib gacmahana kor u dalacaya, jamrada hore iyo ta labaadba. Laakiin jamratul-caqaba(ta weyn) wuu tuurayaa mana ducaynayo, wuxuuna leeyahay marka uu tuurayo dhagax kasta allaahu akbar, kadibna wuu tagayaa, mana istaagayo agteeda

chapters.title: دعاء التعجب والأمر السار
chapters.en: What to say when surprised or startled

items.t: ((سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ!)).
items.e: (How perfect Allah is.)
items.so: ilaahay ayaa ka huffan xumaan iyo ceeba.
items.st: subxaanallaahi !

items.e: (Allah is the greatest.)
items.so: ilaahaybaa weyn ).
items.st: Allaahu akbaru

chapters.title: ما يفعل من أتاه أمر يسره
chapters.en: What to say when something that pleases you happens

items.t: ((كَانَ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ أَمْرٌ يَسُرُّهُ أَوْ يُسَرُّ بِهِ خَرَّ سَاجِداً شُكْراً لِلَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى)).
items.e: (The Prophet PBUH would prostrate in gratitude to Allah upon receiving news which pleased him or which caused pleasure. )
items.so: Wuxuu ahaa rasuulku s.c.w haddii ay u timaado arrink uu ku farxo ama lagu farxo, kii dhaca sujuud shukri naqid uu u shukri naqayo ilaahayga barakada badan ee sarreeya
items.rf: w.w.culumada sunanta nisaai mooyee, eeg: saxiix ibnu maajah 1/233.

chapters.title: ما يقول من أحس وجعا في جسده
chapters.en: What to say when you feel a pain in your body

items.t: ((ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الَّذِي تَألَّمَ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ وَقُلْ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، ثَلاَثاً، وَقُلْ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ)).
items.e: (Place your hand at the site of the pain and say: (In the name of Allah(three times)) the supplicate seven times: (I take refuge in Allah and within His omnipotence from the evil that I feel and am wary of.))
items.so: magaca ilaahay. waxaan uga magan galayaa ilaahay, iyo awoodiisa waxa aan helayo (i haya) sharkiisa iyo waxa aan ka digtoonahayba.
items.st: Saar gacantaada meesha ku xanuunaysa kadibna dheh:{bismillaah, saddex jeer, dhehne tadoba jeer: acuudu billaahi wa qudratihi min sharri maa ajidu wa u xaadiru

chapters.title: دعاء من خشي أن يصيب شيئا بعينه
chapters.en: What to say when you fear you may afflict something with the evil eye

items.t: ((إِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُم مِنْ أَخِيهِ، أَوْ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ، أَوْ مِنْ مَالِهِ مَا يُعْجِبُهُ [فَلْيَدْعُ لَهُ بِالْبَرَكَةِ] فَإِنَّ الْعَيْنَ حَقٌّ)).
items.e: If you see anything of your brother that pleases you, or of his person or of his property [then ask Allah to bless him in it] for the envious eye is real.
items.so: haddii uu ka arko midkiin walaalkiis, ama naftiisa ama maalkiisa wax uu ka helay oo uu u bogay, ha ugu duceeyo barako iyo barwaaqo, ishu waa xaq (dhab

items.t: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ!)).
items.so: ilaah xaq lagu caabudo majiro ilaahay mooyee.
items.st: laa ilaaha illallaah

chapters.title: ما يقول عند الذبح أو النحر
chapters.en: What to say when slaughtering or sacrificing an animal

items.t: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ [اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي)).
items.e: (In the name of Allah, and Allah is the greatest.  O Allah, (it is) from You and belongs to You, O Allah, accept this from me.)
items.so: magaca Eebe ayaan ku gawracayaa, ilaahaybaa weyn, allow (neefkani) adiga xaggaa ayuu ka yimid adigaana leh, allow iga aqbal.
items.st: bismillaah, wallaahu akbar, allaahumma minka wa laka, allaahumma taqabbal minnii

chapters.title: ما يقول لرد كيد مردة الشياطين
chapters.en: What to say to foil the devil's plots

items.t: ((أَعُوذُ بكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لاَ يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلاَ فَاجِرٌ: مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَبَرَأَ وَذَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلاَّ طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ)).
items.e: (I take refuge within Allah’s perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress, from all the evil that He has created, made and originated.  (I take refuge) from the evil that descends from the sky and the evil that rises up to it.  (I take refuge) from the evil that is spread on Earth and the evil that springs from her, and I take refuge from the evil of the tribulations of night and day, and the evil of one who visits at night except the one who brings good, O Merciful One.)
items.so: Waxaan u magan galayaa kalmadaha ilaahay ee dhamayska tiran, kuwaasoo uusan dhaafi Karin muslin iyo gaal toona, ama taqi iyo caasi, waxa uu uumay sharkiis, ee uu abuuray, iyo sharka wax kastoo daga samada, iyo sharka waxa fuula samada, iyo sharka waxa uu ku abuuray dhulka, iyo sharka waxa ka soo baxa dhulka, iyo sharka fitanta habeenkii iyo dharaartii, iyo sharka wax kastoo soo garaaca xiliga habeenkii, ku khayr wado mooyee allihii naxariista guud naxariisanayow.
items.st: acuudu bikalimaatillaahi taammaati allatii laa yujaawizuhunna barrun walaa faajirun min sharri maa khalaqa, wa baraa, wa dara-a, wa min sharri maa yanzilu minassamaai, wa min sharri maa yacruju fiihaa, wa min sharri maa dara-a fil ardi, wa min sharri maa yakhruju minhaa, wa min sharri fitanillayli wannahaari, wa min sharri kulli daariqin illaa daariqan yadruqu bikhayrin yaa raxmaanu

chapters.title: الاستغفار و التوبة
chapters.en: Repentance and seeking forgiveness

items.t: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَسْتَغفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةٍ)).
items.e: (The Messenger of Allah  said: ‘By Allah, I seek forgiveness and repent to Allah, more than seventy times a day.)
items.so: Wuxuu yiri rasuulku s.c.w: wallaahi, anigu waxaan dambidhaaf waydiistaa ilaahay, waana u toobaadkeenaa maalintii in kabadan, todobaatan mar

items.t: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ فِي الْيَوْمِ إِلَيْهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ)).
items.e: (He  also said: ‘O People, Repent! Verily I repent to Allah, a hundred times a day.)
items.so: Wuxuu yiri s.c.w: ( Dadow u toobadkeena ilaahay, anigu waxaan u toobadkeenaa ilaahay maalintiiba boqol mar

items.t: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((مَنْ قَالَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ القَيّوُمُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيهِ، غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ)).
items.e: (He  also said: ‘Whoever says:(I seek Allah’s forgiveness, besides whom, none has the right to be worshipped except He, The Ever Living, The Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, and I turn to Him in repentance.) Allah would forgive him even if he was one who fled during the advance of an army.)
items.so: Wuxuu yiri s.c.w: qofkii yiraahda: (allaha wayn ayaan dambidhaaf waydiisanayaa, ilaah xaq lagu caabudaana majiro isaga mooyee, waana Eebaha nool, khalqigana maamula, waana u toobadkeenayaa) ilaahay wuu u dambi dhaafayaa, xitaa haddii uu kasoo cararay dagaalka (furinta jihaadka

items.t: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الرَّبُّ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ فِي جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرِ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِمَّنْ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ فِي تِلْكَ السَّاعَةِ فَكُنْ)).
items.e: (He  said: ‘The nearest the Lord comes to His servant is in the middle of the night, so if you are able to be of those who remember Allah at that time, then be so.)
items.so: Wuxuu yiri s.c.w: (marka uu ugu dhawyahay ilaahay adoonka waa saqda dhexe ee habeenkii, hadaba haddii aad karto inaad noqotid kuwa ilaahay xussa saacaddaas, ahow

items.t: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ فَأَكثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ)).
items.e: (He  also said: ‘The nearest a servant is to his Lord is when he is prostrating, so supplicate much therein.)
items.so: Wuxuu yiri s.c.w marka uu u dhawyahay adoonku rabbigiis, waa marka uu sujuudsanyahay, ee badiya ducada.

items.t: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((إِنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي وَإِنِّي لأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ)).
items.e: (He  also said: ‘verily my heart becomes preoccupied, and verily I seek Allah’s forgiveness a hundred times a day.)(preoccupied: i.e. in a state of ‘forgetfulness’. The Prophet  always used to increase in his remembrance of his Lord, in attaining a nearness to Allah and having consciousness of Allah to the extent that if this intensity lessened in anyway, he would regard it as a sin and would then race to seek forgiveness from Allah.)
items.so: Wuxuu yiri s.c.w: waa la daboolaa (la ilawsiiyaa) qalbigayaga, waxaana waydiistaa ilaahay dambidhaaf maalintii boqol jeer. Nabigeena s.c.w afka kama qaadijirin xussida ilaahay, hadaba marmar ayuu halmaamijiray mashquul awagiis, taasna dambi ayuu u arki jiray,markuu saa u xasuustana islamarkaaba wuxuu la imaanjiray istiqfaar. 130-.Fadliga tasbiixda &alxamdulilaahida & allaahu akbarta& laa ilaaha illallaahda.

chapters.title: فضل التسبيح و التحميد، و التهليل، و التكبير
chapters.en: The excellence of remembering Allah

items.t: قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَنْ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَلَوْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْر)).
items.e: (Whoever says:(How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.) a hundred times during the day, his sins are wiped away, even if they are like the foam of the sea.)
items.so: Wuxuu yiri s.c.w: qofkii yiraahda maalintii (subxaanallaahi wa bixamdihi)boqol jeer waa laga hoobinayaa danbiyadiisa, haba ahaato xunbada badda oo kale (waa xagga badnaanta).

items.t: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((مَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ عَشْرَ مِرَارٍ، كَانَ كَمَنْ أَعْتَقَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَنْفُسٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ)).
items.e: (Abu Hurayrah  reported that the Messenger of Allah  said: ‘Whoever says: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.) a hundred times during the day, has the reward of freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds are recorded for him and a hundred bad deeds are wiped away and he has gained refuge from the devil that day until evening and none shall come with anything better except someone who has done more.)
items.so: Wuxuu yiri s.c.w: laa ilaaha illallaahu waxdahu laa shariika lahu,lahul mulku walahulxamdu wahuwa calaa kulli shay-in qadiir toban jeer. Qofkii yiraahda wuxuu lamid noqonayaa qof xoreeyey afar nafood oo ka mid ah awlaadda nabi ismaaciil.

items.t: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ)).
items.e: (Aboo Hurayrah  reported that the Messenger of Allah  said:’(There are) Two words, (which are ) light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale and beloved to The Most Gracious: (How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. How perfect Allah is, The Supreme.))
items.so: Wuxuu yiri s.c.w: laba kalmadood oo khafiif ku ah carrabka, kuna culus miisaanka, looguna jacaylbadanyahay xagga raxmaanka, subxaanallaahi wa bixamdihi, subxaanallaahilcadiim.

items.t: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((لَأَنْ أَقُولَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمسُ)).
items.e: (Aboo Hurayrah  reported that the Messenger of Allah  said: ‘Saying: (How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest.) is more beloved to me than everything the sun has risen over.)
items.so: Wuxuu yiri s.c.w: in aan dhaho subxaanallahi walxamdulillaahi walaa ilaaha illallaahu wallaahu akbar ayaan ka jeclahay waxa ay qorraxdu ku soo baxday oo dhan.

items.t: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُم أَنْ يَكْسِبَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ)) فَسَأَلَهُ سَائِلٌ مِنْ جُلَسَائِهِ كَيْفَ يَكْسِبُ أَحَدُنَا أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ؟ قَالَ: ((يُسَبِّحُ مِائَةَ تَسْبِيحَةٍ، فَيُكتَبُ لَهُ أَلْفُ حَسَنَةٍ أَوْ يُحَطُّ عَنْهُ أَلْفُ خَطِيئَةٍ)).
items.e: (Sa’d  said: ‘We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah , and he said: ‘Are any of you unable to gain a thousand good deeds each day?’ Somebody then asked him  : How does one achieve a thousand good deeds? He replied: ‘He should say: (How perfect Allah is.) one hundred times, for a thousand good deeds are recorded for him or a thousand bad deeds are wiped away.)
items.so: Wuxuu yiri s.c.w: ma ka caajisayaa midkiin in uu kasbado maalin kasta kun xasano(ajir)? Markaasuu weydiiyay weydiiye kamid ahaa dadkii la fadhiyay: sidee u kasban karaa midkanagu kun xasano? Wuxuu yiri rasuulku s.c.w: wuxuu tasbiixsanayaa boqol tasbiixasho markaasaa loo qori kun xasano, lagana hoobin kun khadii-o (danbi).:

items.t: ((مَنْ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ غُرِسَتْ لَهُ نَخْلَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ)).
items.e: (Jabbir  related that the Prophet  said: ‘Whoever says: (How perfect Allah is . The Supreme, and I praise Him.) a palm tree is planted for him in paradise.)
items.so: qofkii yiraahda: (subxaanallaahilcadiim wa bixamdihi) waxaa loogu beer- ayaa jannada dhexdeeda geed timir ah

items.t: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَنْزٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ))؟ فَقُلْتُ: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: ((قُلْ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ)).
items.e: (AAabdullah Ibn Qays  related that the Prophet  said to him: ‘ O ‘AAabdullah Ibn Qays, shall I not inform you of a treasure from the treasures of paradise?’ He  then said: ‘Say: (There is no might nor power except with Allah.))
items.so: Wuxuu yiri s.c.w: cabdilaahi ibnu qaysow ma ku tusaa kayd kaydadka jannada kamid ah? Wuxuu yiri: haa i tusi, wuxuu yiri rasuulku s.c.w: waxaad tiraahdaa:( laa xawla walaa quwwata illaa billaahi.

items.t: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((أَحَبُّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَرْبَعٌ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لاَ يَضُرُّكَ بِأَيِّهِنَّ بَدَأتَ)).
items.e: (the most beloved words to Allah are four: (How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.))(it does not matter which of them you start with.)
items.so: Wuxuu yiri s.c.w: hadalka ilaahay ugu jecelyahay waa afar: subxaanallaahi, walxamdulilaahi walaa ilaaha illal- laahu, wallaahu akbaru kuma dhibayso midkasta ood ku billowdo.

items.t: جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: عَلِّمْنِي كَلاماً أَقُولُهُ: قَالَ: ((قُلْ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيراً، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ)) قَالَ: فَهَؤُلاَءِ لِرَبِّي، فَمَا لِي؟ قَالَ: ((قُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي)).
items.e: (SaAAd Ibn Abee Waqqas  narrated that a man came to the Messenger of Allah  and said to him: ‘Teach me something which I should say?’ He said: ‘Say: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partener. Allah is most great and much praise is for Allah. How perfect Allah is, Lord of the worlds. There is no might nor power except with Allah, The Exalted in might, The Wise.) the man then said: ‘These are for my Lord, and what is for me?’ He  replied: ‘Say:(O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me and grant me sustenance.))
items.so: allow ii dambi dhaaf, iina naxariiso, ina hanuuni, ina irsaaq.
items.st: Nin reer miyyi ah ayaa u yimid rasuulka s.c.w markaa suu ku yiri: i bar hadal aan dhaho: markaa suu yiris.c.w: dheh: laa ilaaha illallaahu waxdahu laa shariika lahu, allaahu akbar kabiiraa, walxamdu lillaahi kathiiraa, subxaanallaahi rabbil caalamiina, laa xawla walaa quwwata illaa billaahi al-caziizi alxakiimi) wuxuu yiri ninkii: kuwani waa kuwii rabigay, ee anigu maxaan leeyahay? Wuxuu ku yiri rasuulku s.c.w: dheh: allaahumma iqfir lii, warxamnii, wahdinii, warzuqnii

items.t: كَانَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا أَسْلَمَ عَلَّمَهُ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّلاَةَ ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ بِهَؤُلاَءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرِ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي)).
items.e: (Tariq Al-AshjaAAee  said: ‘When someone would embrace Islam, the Prophet  would teach him how to perform prayer and then order him to supplicate with the following words: (O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, give me health and grant me sustenance.))
items.so: allow ii dambi dhaaf, iina naxariiso, ina hanuuni, ina irsaaq.
items.st: Wuxuu ahaa ninku haddii uu islaamo kii uu baro nabigu s.c.w salaada, kadibna wuxuu amrijiray inuu ku ducaysto kalmadahan: (allaahumma iqfir lii, warxamnii, wahdinii, warzuqnii

items.t: ((إِنَّ أَفْضَلَ الدُّعَاءِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَأَفْضَلَ الذِّكْرِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ)).
items.e: (Jabir  Ibn ‘AAabdullah  related that the Messenger of Allah  said: ‘Verily, the best supplication is: (All praise is for Allah.) and indeed, the best form of remembrance is: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.))
items.so: Duco waxaa ugu fiican ( alxamdu lillaahi) xusidna waxaa ugu fiican (laa ilaaha illallaahu)

items.t: الباقيات الصالحات : سبحان الله والحمد لله ، ولا إله إلا الله ،والله أكبر ،و لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
items.e: The good deeds which endure are 'Glorified is Allah', and 'The praise is for Allah', and 'but There is none worthy of worship Allah', and 'Allah is the Most Great', and 'There is no power and no might except by Allah'
items.so: erayada hadha ee wanaagsan waa kuwan: ( subxaanallaahi, walxamdu lillaahi, wa laa ilaaha illallaahu, wallaahu akbaru, walaa xawla walaa quwwata illaa billaahi ).

chapters.title: كيف كان النبي يسبح؟
chapters.en: How the Prophet glorified Allah

items.t: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رضي الله عنه قَالَ: ((رَأَيْتُ النَّبيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْقِدُ التَّسْبِيحَ)) وفي زيادةٍ: ((بِيَمِينِهِ)).
items.e: (Tasbeeh, it means here, to say: (Subhanal-lah, alhamdu lillah, Allahu akbar.)) (AAabdullah Ibn AAamr  said: ’I saw the prophet  make tasbeeh with his right hand.)
items.so: Waxaa laga wariyey c/laahi ibnu camar r.c inuu yidhi: waxaan arkay nabiga s.c.w oo gaccantiisa midig ku tasbiixsanaya.

chapters.title: من أنواع الخير والآداب الجامعة
chapters.en: Types of goodness and good etiquette for community life

items.t: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ((إِذَا كَانَ جُنْحُ اللَّيْلِ – أَوْ أَمْسَيْتُم – فَـكُفُّوا صِبْيانَـكُم، فَإِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ تَنْتَشِرُ حِينَئِذٍ، فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ سَاعَةٌ مِنَ اللَّيلِ فَخَلُّوهُمْ، وَأَغْلِقُوا الأَبْوَابَ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ؛ فَإِنَّ الشَّيطَانَ لاَ يَفْتَحُ بَاباً مُغلَقاً، وَأَوْكُوا قِرَبَكُمْ، وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ، وَخَمِّرُوا آنِيَتَكُم، وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ، وَلَوْ أَنْ تَعْرُضُوا عَلَيْهَا شَيْئاً، وَأَطْفِئُوا مَصَابِيحَكُمْ)).
items.e: When evening descends, bring your children indoors for the devils scatter out at this hour. Then after the passing of an hour (i.e. the first hour) of the night, (you may) let them (the children) go. Close your doors while mentioning the Name of Allah, for the devil may not open a closed door. Fasten your waterskins mentioning the Name of Allah. Cover your eating vessels mentioning the Name of Allah even if you just put something over it, and extinguish your lamps. Peace and blessing be upon our Prophet, Muhammad, and upon his family and his Companions, all of them.
items.so: markay noqoto habeenkii ama aad habeensataan, caruurtiina reebta, shayaadiinta ayaa faafta waqtigaase, markii ay ka tagto saacadi habeenka, siidaaya caruurta, kadibna xirta albaabadiina, magaca ilaahayna xussa,shaydaankuna ma furo albaab xiran, dhiilihiinana,ama weel-biyoodkiina xira, magaca ilaahayna xussa, weelashiinana daboosha, walow aad ku gudubtaan shay- un, magaca ilaahayna xussa, faynuustiinana damiya
